sentences: **Wittgenstein's Picture Theory**: Wittgenstein was **deeply troubled** by questions of meaning and logic.
In his work, the **Tractatus Logico-Philosophicus**, he developed the **"picture theory"** of meaning.
It emphasized that language succeeds in representing facts by **picturing them**.
He likened representing facts through language to arranging **toy cars in the positions of real cars in an accident**.
He believed that each **meaningful sentence** could be translated into an **ideal language**.
This ideal language would be composed of **simple propositions**, such as **the words "or," "and," and "not."**
This work was influential in **20th-century philosophy**.
